mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuing process in a plant and cannot be stopped without damage to the growing plant or harvested produce."
Respiration is a continuing process in a plant and cannot be stopped without damage to the growing plant or harvested produce.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important determinant of storage-life and final fruit quality."
Maturity at harvest is the most important determinant of storage-life and final fruit quality.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most common medium for transferring heat to a drying tissue and convection is mainly involved."
A current of air is the most common medium for transferring heat to a drying tissue and convection is mainly involved.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an appropriate, effective and inexpensive means of providing low temperature and high relative humidity conditions for cooling produce."
Evaporative cooling Evaporative cooling is an appropriate, effective and inexpensive means of providing low temperature and high relative humidity conditions for cooling produce.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the ratio of the partial pressure of water vapour in the air to the vapour pressure of pure water at the same temperature."
Relative humidity is defined as the ratio of the partial pressure of water vapour in the air to the vapour pressure of pure water at the same temperature.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the task that constitutes the concluding stage of land cultivation."
Harvesting of crops generally is the task that constitutes the concluding stage of land cultivation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means of food preservation in tropical countries."
Lactic-acid fermentation as a low-cost means of food preservation in tropical countries.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the sequence of changes in texture, colour and flavour as a result of physiological and biochemical change that makes the fruit ready for consumption."
Ripening is defined as the sequence of changes in texture, colour and flavour as a result of physiological and biochemical change that makes the fruit ready for consumption.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a preservation technology which involves as a preliminary processing step a weak lactic fermentation followed by acidification (vinegar addition)."
Combined acidification is a preservation technology which involves as a preliminary processing step a weak lactic fermentation followed by acidification (vinegar addition).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a developing technology still being researched."
PEF for food processing is a developing technology still being researched.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the hermetically sealed bag or cocoon of various sizes (1 - 300 metric ton), which appear to offer good possibilities to store grain in a variety of quantities."

Hermetic Cocoons A relatively new development is the hermetically sealed bag or cocoon of various sizes (1 - 300 metric ton), which appear to offer good possibilities to store grain in a variety of quantities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ultimate product of flour milling."
White flour is the ultimate product of flour milling.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the food processing technologies available to the food industry to control organisms that cause food-borne diseases and to reduce food losses due to spoilage and deterioration."

Food irradiation is one of the food processing technologies available to the food industry to control organisms that cause food-borne diseases and to reduce food losses due to spoilage and deterioration.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used as a solid (dry ice) in many countries as a means of low- temperature storage and transportation of food products."
Carbon dioxide is used as a solid (dry ice) in many countries as a means of low- temperature storage and transportation of food products.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to cool a variety of commodities."
Top icing Top icing is used to cool a variety of commodities.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the method for extending the shelf-life of perishable and semi-perishable food products by altering the relative proportions of atmospheric gases that surround the produce."

Modified atmosphere packaging is the method for extending the shelf-life of perishable and semi-perishable food products by altering the relative proportions of atmospheric gases that surround the produce.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important food condiment in Nigeria and many countries of West andCentral Africa (21)."
Dadawa or iru is the most important food condiment in Nigeria and many countries of West andCentral Africa (21).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a particular stage in the development of a plant or plant organ."
Physiological maturity -This refers to a particular stage in the development of a plant or plant organ.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a rapid beating with a wire whisk, a fork or mechanical beater."
Beating (or whipping) is a rapid beating with a wire whisk, a fork or mechanical beater.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to mix food materials or food ingredients or caused to be combined during food preparation in order to improve the palatability of the end product."
Combination or Mixing This method is used to mix food materials or food ingredients or caused to be combined during food preparation in order to improve the palatability of the end product.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used, and they are looped round each yam and pulled tight so that each yam rests against the upright pole and often against the horizontal pole as well."
Long pieces of fibre are used, and they are looped round each yam and pulled tight so that each yam rests against the upright pole and often against the horizontal pole as well.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an excellent cooling method, despite the fact that the produce is wet during the process."
Liquid icing is an excellent cooling method, despite the fact that the produce is wet during the process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the commonest form of yam storage in West Africa."
The barn is the commonest form of yam storage in West Africa.
